newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close higher, spread buying noted.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close higher, spread buying noted.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed firmer with the most-active January contract ending above support seen at 100.00.
Traders cited buying in November/January spread.
January gained 0.75 on the day to close at 101.65, having ranged from 101.95 to 101.05. November finished 1.00 higher at 111.00.
Merrill Lynch analyst Judith Ganes said prices are likely to hold current levels through Christmas, based on the recent speculation and hedging report.
The report showed speculators net long by 11.2 percent compared with 40.8 percent a year ago.
"The striking comparison heading into the winter months is one of the main reasons why we see limited downside potential," Ganes said.
